entity.label: Hiri Current
entity.source_kind: northward western boundary branch and Gulf of Papua circulation

limitations: This packet is a screened source-set excerpt, not a complete global inventory.
Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Editorial Coral Sea point offshore northern Queensland on the northward branch described in the source; naming extent around the Gulf of Papua remains unsettled.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The literature uses Hiri Current for the northward branch after South Equatorial Current bifurcation off northeast Australia, with variable continuation around the Gulf of Papua. No one fixed path or endpoint pair is admitted for a whole-current length.
